Player.Name: Player
Player.Description: You are Elara, your calloused hands tracing the worn leather straps of your explorer's pack. The midday sun warms your neck, but a chill lingers in the damp air that clings to the dense jungle foliage surrounding you. Sweat beads on your brow, mingling with the dirt smudged across your cheek from yesterday's scramble up a treacherous cliff face. Your eyes, the color of moss after a spring rain, scan the tangled undergrowth for signs of movement: a flash of crimson scales, the rustle of unseen wings, or perhaps the glint of metal reflecting the sun through a canopy of emerald leaves. A faded map crinkles in your grip, its edges fraying from countless unfurling and refolding.
Player.Actions: {  "actions": [    {      "name": "Initialize",      "command": { "$type": "var.set", "Name": "game.started", "Value": "true" },      "condition": {        "$type": "var.equals",        "Name": "game.started",        "Value": "true",        "CaseInsensitive": false,        "commands": [          { "$type": "var.set", "Name": "player.health", "Value": "100" },          { "$type": "var.set", "Name": "player.energy", "Value": "50" },          { "$type": "var.set", "Name": "player.state", "Value": "idle" }        ]      }    },    {      "name": "Enter Start Room",      "command": { "$type": "player.moveTo", "RoomId": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001" },      "condition": {        "$type": "var.equals",        "Name": "player.state",        "Value": "idle",        "CaseInsensitive": true,        "commands": [          { "$type": "var.set", "Name": "ui.message", "Value": "You step into the starting room." },          { "$type": "var.set", "Name": "room.welcomeShown", "Value": "true" },          { "$type": "var.set", "Name": "player.state", "Value": "exploring" }        ]      }    },    {      "name": "Show Intro",      "command": { "$type": "var.set", "Name": "intro.shown", "Value": "true" },      "condition": {        "$type": "var.equals",        "Name": "intro.shown",        "Value": "false",        "CaseInsensitive": false,        "commands": [          { "$type": "var.set", "Name": "ui.tip1", "Value": "Use WASD to move." },          { "$type": "var.set", "Name": "ui.tip2", "Value": "Open inventory with I." },          { "$type": "var.set", "Name": "ui.tip3", "Value": "Check the map with M." }        ]      }    }  ]}
